project.name: Gimle Example: greeter-load-generator
project.description: A third companion to greeter-provider/greeter-consumer: a real, deployable Gimle module whose only job is to translate inbound HTTP requests into real ModuleContext#lookupService calls against greeter-provider's Greeter -- the bridge an external HTTP load generator (Gatling, in gimle-smoke-tests' own real-cluster QA) needs to drive genuine, high-rate fabric traffic against a deployed instance, since the fabric's own wire protocol has no client outside a hosted module. Every inbound HTTP request is exactly one real cross-worker fabric call (both modules are TIER_2, dedicated workers), so the request rate Gatling controls becomes greeter-provider's own real, worker-reported requestRatePerSecond -- the actual signal AutoscaleReconciler's multi-metric policy reads, not a synthetic stand-in for it. Same requires-static/addReads story as greeter-provider -- see its own description.
